title: Activation of barium titanate for photocatalytic overall water splitting via low-valence cation codoping
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01323B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shigeru Ikeda, Kaori Takagi, Ryota Tomizawa, Tomoya Nagano, Koji Hayashi, Akira Yamakata, Yoshitaro Nose
Low-valence cation codoping at Ti4+ sites under flux treatment transforms BaTiO3 from an inactive perovskite into an unprecedentedly efficient photocatalyst for overall water splitting, achieving 27.5% apparent quantum yield (AQY) at 365 nm.
